3.translation: How do you know what the Inevitable Hour is?

4.translation: Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Striking Calamity of the Hour[1].
4.footnotes: [1] The Striking Calamity is one of the names of the Day of Judgment.

5.translation: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by a dreadful blast.

6.translation: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a furious windstorm[2]

7.translation: which He unleashed against them for seven successive nights and eight days, so you would see the people lying dead as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

8.translation: Do you see any trace of them now?

9.translation: Also, Pharaoh and those who came before him, and the overturned cities [of Lot] committed the grave sin,

10.translation: each disobeying the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a severe punishment.

11.translation: Indeed, when the floodwater overflowed, We carried you [O humans] in the sailing Ark[3],
11.footnotes: [3] Which was made by Noah with Allah's command.

12.translation: so that We might make it a reminder for you, and that attentive ears may take heed.

13.translation: Then when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,

14.translation: and the earth and mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single blow,

15.translation: on that Day the Inevitable Event will occur.

16.translation: And the sky will split asunder and will be frail[4] on that day,

17.translation: with the angels on all its sides, and on that Day, eight [mighty angels] will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

18.translation: On that day, you will be brought forth [before Allah], and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

19.translation: As for the one who is given his Record in his right hand, he will say, “Here is my Record, read it!

20.translation: I was sure that I would meet my reckoning.”

21.translation: So he will be in a pleasant life,

23.translation: with clustered fruit within his reach.

24.translation: [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did[5] in the days gone by.”
24.footnotes: [5] Lit., "advanced" anticipating the reward in the Hereafter.

25.translation: As for the one who is given his Record in his left hand, he will say, “Would that I had not been given my Record,

26.translation: nor had I known anything of my reckoning!

27.translation: Would that it [i.e., death] had been the end of me[6]!
27.footnotes: [6] Rather than a gateway to eternal life.

28.translation: My wealth has been of no avail to me.

29.footnotes: [7] i.e., I have no valid argument or authority today.

30.translation: [It will be said,] “Seize him and shackle him,

31.translation: then make him burn in the Blazing Fire,

32.translation: then tie him up with a chain of seventy cubits long.

33.translation: For he did not believe in Allah, the Most Great,

34.translation: nor did he encourage feeding the needy.

35.translation: So Today he will have no close friend here,

36.translation: nor any food except the discharge of wounds,

37.translation: none will eat it except the sinners.”

38.translation: I swear by what you can see.

40.translation: Indeed, this is the word of a noble Messenger[8],

41.translation: and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe!

42.translation: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer; little do you take heed!

43.translation: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

44.translation: If he had falsely attributed something to Us,

45.translation: We would have surely seized him by the right hand[9],
45.footnotes: [9] Or "by [Our] Right Hand," i.e., Allah would have surely exacted revenge with might and power.

46.footnotes: [10] i.e., his life artery of the heart; causing immediate death.

47.translation: and none of you could have rescued him.

48.translation: This [Qur’an] is indeed a reminder for those who are righteous.

49.translation: And We surely know that some of you will be deniers,

50.translation: and it[11] will certainly be a source of regret for the disbelievers.

51.translation: And this[12] is indeed the absolute truth.

52.translation: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
